The '''Hewett sector''' was located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] and contained the [[Dalon system|Dalon]], [[Hewett system/Legends|Hewett]], [[Mackar system/Legends|Mackar]], and [[Vectinia system/Legends|Vectinia systems]]. The Dalon and Mackar [[Star system/Legends|systems]] included the astronomical objects [[Moer]] and [[Mackar]], respectively. Mackar was the original [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Frid]] [[Species/Legends|species]], and the Hewett system was home to the sentients of the [[Hewett|same name]]. By [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the Hewett [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was a part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], and a [[Battle of Hewett|battle]] was fought between that government and the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] in the Hewett system that [[Standard year/Legends|year]].

==Description==
The Hewett [[Sector/Legends|sector]] was located in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="New Territories" /> By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], it bordered the [[Hollan sector/Legends|Hollan sector]] [[Core Worlds/Legends|Coreward]], the [[M'shinni sector/Legends|M'shinni]] and [[Ottega sector/Legends|Ottega sectors]] [[spinward]], and the [[Strabin sector/Legends|Strabin sector]] in the [[trailing]] direction. The Hewett sector also formed a part of the Mid Rim's [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Rimward]] border with the Outer Rim Territories' [[Noonian sector/Legends|Noonian sector]].<ref name="Mid Rim" />

The northern section of the Hewett sector contained the [[Hewett system/Legends|Hewett]] and [[Mackar system/Legends|Mackar systems]], and the [[Dalon system|Dalon]] and [[Vectinia system/Legends|Vectinia systems]] lay in the sector's southern portion.<ref name="Directions">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} places the Hewett [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Star system/Legends|systems]] of [[Hewett system/Legends|Hewett]] and [[Mackar system/Legends|Mackar]] in grid square M-6 and [[Dalon system|Dalon]] and [[Vectinia system/Legends|Vectinia]] in square M-7, which corresponds to the northern and southern section of the sector, respectively, according to {{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim|text=Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim}}.</ref> A [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] running through the Hewett and Vectinia [[Star system/Legends|systems]] connected the sector to the [[Tartaglia system/Legends|Tartaglia system]] in the Hollan sector as well as the Noonian sector's [[Er'Kit system/Legends|Er'Kit system]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==History==
By [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], the Hewett sector formed a part of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] border with the Outer Rim Territories&ndash;based [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the latter's [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] triumphed over the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic military]] in a [[Battle of Hewett|confrontation]] in the Hewett system.<ref name="EGTW" />

==Locations==
[[File:Frid.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Hewett sector world Mackar was the original homeworld of the Frid species.]]
The Vectinia system was home to [[Species/Legends|creatures]] known as [[Vectinian spider]]s,<ref name="Planetnamia" /><ref name="GSW1">''[[A Guide to the Star Wars Universe]]''</ref> and the Hewett system was the point of origin of<ref name="JE" /><ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Hewett]] species. Hewett [[Senator/Legends|senators]] represented their system in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="JE" /> by [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="32 BBY">''[[Episode I Adventures 4: Jedi Emergency]]'' establishes that [[Hewett]] [[Senator/Legends|senators]] were a part of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] while [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] was still alive. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates Jinn's [[Death/Legends|death]] during the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]] to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the Hewett must have gained Senate representation by that date.</ref>

The Dalon and Mackar systems each contained<ref name="EAOC" /> a terrestrial astronomical object: [[Moer]]<ref name="Journal10">{{JournalCite|10|A Free-Trader's Guide to the Planets}}</ref> and the [[Waterworld/Legends|water world]] [[Mackar]], respectively.<ref name="Gamer1" /> Moer was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[free-trader]] [[Liadden]],<ref name="Journal10" /> and Mackar was the original home of the sentient [[Frid]].<ref name="Gamer1" /> At some point five [[Millennium/Legends|thousand years]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]],<ref name="5000 years">{{CSWECite|II|119|Iskalonian}} states that the [[Species/Legends|species]] constituting the [[Iskalonian]] cultural group, which includes the [[Frid]] of [[Mackar]] per "[[The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Marvel Series]]," were brought to [[Iskalon/Legends|Iskalon]] approximately five [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]] before the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Since the latter source establishes that the relocation of the Iskalonian species was prefaced by the cataclysms on the species' original [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworlds]], the cataclysms must also have occurred around that [[Time/Legends|time]].</ref> a series of cataclysms occurred on several water [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], including Mackar. Subsequently, a [[Spacefaring benefactors|group]] of [[Realspace/Legends|spacefaring]] benefactors arrived and helped relocate the species of the affected worlds to the<ref name="Gamer1" /> [[Trans-Nebular sector/Legends|Trans-Nebular sector]]<ref name="EAOC Iskalon">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Iskalon system/Legends|Iskalon system]]</ref> planet [[Iskalon/Legends|Iskalon]].<ref name="Gamer1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hewett sector was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="EAOC" /> In [[2012]], the sector was depicted on a map designed by [[Modi]] and published in the Online Companion feature "[https://www.starwars.com/news/essential-atlas-extra-sectors-of-the-mid-rim Essential Atlas Extra: Sectors of the Mid Rim]," which placed it in grid squares M-6 and M-7.<ref name="Mid Rim" />
